name: dsh-memory
description: Intelligent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness. Remember what matters. Resolve what conflicts. Forget what no longer should remain.

scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --eval "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');function walk(d,a=[]){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p,a);else if(p.endsWith('.ts'))a.push(p);}return a;}const files=walk('src').concat(walk('tests'),walk('examples'),walk('benchmarks'));let bad=0;for(const f of files){const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(/\bany\b/.test(t.replace(/\/\/.*$/gm,'').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,''))){const lines=t.split(/\n/);lines.forEach((l,i)=>{if(/:\s*any\b|<any>|as any\b/.test(l)&&!l.includes('eslint')){console.error(f+':'+(i+1)+': unexpected any');bad++;}});} } if(bad) process.exit(1);"
